title: networking-fun lab manifest
description: Schema for .platform/manifest.yaml. Validates the lab/scenario/ttl/notes declared by a PR. The per-lab scenario whitelist (e.g. nacl-stateless-return is only valid for three-tier-segmentation, nacl-deny-egress is only valid for layered-reachability) is enforced by .github/scripts/validate-manifest.py, not by this schema's enums, because JSON Schema's `oneOf` over conditional enums is awkward to read; the union is captured here and the script narrows it.

scenario.description: Scenario for the chosen lab. Each lab accepts a subset of these (enforced by the validator script).

ttl.description: Time-to-live duration (e.g. 30m, 2h). Capped at 4h by the validator; default 4h.

notes.description: Free-text note rendered in the PR comment.
